accepted_behavior: OutboundNeighborResolution distinguishes cached resolved destinations from unresolved destinations
resolve_outbound_neighbor reads immutable ArpCache state without allocation
known destination IPv4 resolves to the cached destination MacAddress
cache miss returns an unresolved result carrying the destination IPv4
updated ArpCache entries are reflected by later resolver calls
zero-capacity ArpCache instances remain deterministic misses
cache-aware poll learning remains compatible with later cached resolution

findings.finding: Phase 12.3 now has accepted cached-only outbound IPv4-to-MAC resolution through immutable ArpCache lookup semantics
unresolved-neighbor classification is deterministic and carries the target IPv4 without ARP request emission, packet queueing, or driver consultation
deterministic no_std tests cover cached hit, unresolved miss, updated entry, zero-capacity miss, and cache-aware poll compatibility
no implementation correction was required during closeout because static/source/task evidence matched the accepted core claims

outbound frame construction, ARP request emission, retry timers, packet queues, routing, driver transmit scheduling, live packet I/O, sockets, SSH, smoltcp integration, and Pi 5 packet movement evidence remain future bounded work
no source, docs, dependencies, prior task evidence, or accepted APIs were removed by this closeout

ARP request emission, packet queue readiness, live packet I/O, hardware-driver readiness, link readiness, ping/network reachability behavior, sockets, SSH, smoltcp adoption, and phase transition are not accepted by this closeout
